HE MARRIED ME FOR PEACE. HE KEPT ME FOR POSSESSION.

★★★★★ "Caterina and Marcello have the kind of chemistry that feels dangerous from the very first page. I couldn't decide whether I wanted her to escape him or surrender completely." – Reader Review

My name is Caterina Rinaldi, and the wedding dress wrapped around my body feels more like a burial shroud than silk.

I was traded to settle a blood feud that began long before I was born. My father handed me over to the very family he taught me to hate, and now I belong to Marcello Vieri, the coldest and most dangerous man I have ever known.

He does not want my love.

He wants my obedience.

Marcello expected a frightened bride who would lower her eyes and accept her fate. Instead, he found a woman determined to fight him inside every locked room of his cliffside fortress.

I promised myself I would never become his.

But hatred becomes harder to hold when his touch feels like fire, when his protection begins to resemble devotion, and when the family I trusted proves far more dangerous than the husband I was forced to marry.

Marcello says I am his wife.

His responsibility.

His possession.

And when my own blood marks me for death, the monster beside me may be the only person willing to keep me alive.

Fatal Possession is Book 1 of 3 in The Fatal Desires Series—a dark mafia romance filled with forced marriage, enemies-to-lovers tension, dangerous family secrets, possessive obsession, betrayal, and a ruthless man who will destroy anyone who threatens what belongs to him.
